notes.title: Twitch Integration Optimization + small graphic update
notes.notes:
- further optimization regarding twitch integration
- graphical update in the container levels
- added option to change screen resolution (experimental)
- consolidated car materials to reduce game file size and more fps

notes.title: Twitch Integration Optimization Lag Fix
notes.notes:
Twitch Integration:
- added Twitch Chat message limit, 10 messages per second for twitch Integration to prevent FPS drop caused my too many messages in a short amount of time.
- In-game Twitch Chat box will clear every 3 seconds to prevent FPS drop due to too many messages stored in the Text field.
- Lowest cooldown for twitch commands increased to 5 seconds.

Other:
- Optimization for Cheese Pickup Animation
